decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming your opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, supported by burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah for added versatility. The mana base is optimized for consistent early aggression, utilizing fetchlands like Marsh Flats and Arid Mesa alongside dual lands like Sacred Foundry. With a mix of creatures, burn spells, and planeswalkers, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly deploy low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Slickshot Show-Off, while using efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to control the board and finish off opponents. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells like Expressive Iteration and Preordain to keep the pressure on. The inclusion of cards like Cori-Steel Cutter and Violent Urge provide additional synergy and aggression to the deck, making it a fast and efficient aggro option in the Modern format.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly establish a strong board presence using low-cost creatures and consistently apply pressure to the opponent. It focuses on aggressive plays and utilizing powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Voice of Victory to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge to control the board and maintain the aggression. The mana base is optimized for efficient mana production and the inclusion of cards like Guide of Souls and Seasoned Pyromancer helps to maintain card advantage and board presence.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving Basking Broodscale, Glaring Fleshraker, and Blade of the Bloodchief to create an overwhelming board presence. It utilizes cards like Ancient Stirrings and Urza's Saga to search for key pieces and ramp into powerful threats like Emrakul, the Promised End. Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command provide disruption and removal, while Vexing Bauble and Haywire Mite help generate additional value. Overall, the deck seeks to rapidly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board state.

This deck focuses on aggressively using creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco to deal damage quickly to the opponent. Stubborn Denial and Leyline Binding provide disruption to control the opponent's spells and board. Leyline of the Guildpact boosts the power of multicolored cards like Quantum Riddler and Practiced Offense. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Wrath of the Skies to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and disrupt their game plan to secure victory.

The deck focuses on using Neoform and Eldritch Evolution to quickly tutor and cheat out powerful creatures like Griselbrand, Allosaurus Rider, Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. By generating a large amount of mana through cards like Planar Genesis and Xenagos, God of Revels, the deck can combo off quickly and overwhelm the opponent with big creatures. The deck also includes some protection with Veil of Summer and Pact of Negation to ensure the combos go off smoothly.

This deck focuses on generating mana quickly and efficiently to cast multiple spells in a single turn, leading up to a powerful finishing move like a massive Grapeshot. By reducing the cost of spells with Ruby Medallion and Ral, Monsoon Mage, and utilizing cards like Manamorphose and Pyretic Ritual, the deck aims to chain together spells to create a storm of powerful effects. Past in Flames allows for spells to be recast from the graveyard, while Wish provides flexibility in finding key cards. The deck also includes utility lands and cards to help smooth out draws and protect against disruption.

The main concept of this UW Control deck is to control the game by countering spells, board wiping, and drawing cards with cards such as Narset, Teferi, and Solitude. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage and eventually winning the game through card advantage and board control. The deck utilizes a mix of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to outvalue opponents and maintain control of the game until it can establish a win condition, such as through Teferi, Hero of Dominaria or attacking with creatures like Hall of Storm Giants.

The deck focuses on filling up the graveyard with creatures and then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent with a sudden influx of powerful creatures. Cards like Endurance and Street Wraith help facilitate this strategy by enabling efficient graveyard filling, while cards like Shardless Agent and Curator of Mysteries provide additional value when cascade triggers occur. The deck seeks to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up for a game-winning Living End play.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive Eldrazi creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes various mana ramp options such as Eldrazi Temple and Cavern of Souls to play powerful Eldrazi creatures like Sire of Seven Deaths and Thought-Knot Seer. Chalice of the Void and Ugin's Labyrinth are used for disruption, while Sowing Mycospawn provides token generation. The goal is to establish a strong board presence and apply pressure to the opponent with large Eldrazi creatures, supported by efficient mana sources and disruptive spells.

The main concept of this Esper Control deck is to control the game through disruption and removal spells, while also utilizing creatures with powerful abilities to pressure the opponent. The deck aims to create card advantage through efficient removal and card draw effects, allowing the player to out-value their opponent in the later stages of the game. With a mix of hand disruption, removal spells, and powerful creatures, the deck is designed to handle a variety of threats and maintain control of the battlefield.

This deck revolves around using Broodscale Bloodchief to create a powerful combo with creatures like Glaring Fleshraker and Basking Broodscale. By quickly ramping up with Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with large creatures and powerful abilities. With support cards like Blade of the Bloodchief and Malevolent Rumble, the deck can control the board and generate advantage. Emrakul, the Promised End and Kozilek's Command provide additional win conditions and disruption. The deck also includes key lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Ugin's Labyrinth to further support the combo strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying artifacts and using cards like Mishra's Bauble and Thoughtcast to draw into more threats. It utilizes cards like Mox Opal and Welding Jar to ramp up mana and protect key pieces. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and disruption while also generating value through cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch. The inclusion of Urza's Saga provides further utility and the ability to tutor for additional threats, creating a synergistic game plan that aims to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on assembling a combo with Broodscale Bloodchief by generating Eldrazi tokens with Basking Broodscale and saccing them with Glaring Fleshraker for a powerful effect. It also utilizes cards like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble for disruption and removal. The deck includes ramp cards like Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga to quickly get out powerful threats like Emrakul, the Promised End. The deck leans heavily on synergy between cards to create a fast and resilient game plan that can overwhelm opponents with a strong board presence.

This combo deck revolves around filling your graveyard with creatures using cards like Faithless Looting and Stitcher's Supplier, then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield. Archon of Cruelty is a key creature to reanimate, as its ability can exile your opponent's hand and graveyard. Electrodominance can also be used to cast Living End at instant speed. The deck also includes cards like Flare of Malice and Archfiend's Vessel for additional synergy and interaction with your graveyard. The goal is to overwhelm your opponent with a powerful board state and win quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Cosmogoyf combo in order to quickly build up the graveyard and overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells and creatures. By using cards like Revitalizing Repast, Rite of Consumption, and Soul Spike, along with Duress and Inquisition of Kozilek to disrupt the opponent's strategy, this deck aims to control the game and secure a quick victory. Additionally, the use of Necrodominance and Plunge into Darkness allows for additional graveyard manipulation and card advantage, further enhancing the combo potential of the deck.
